references.observed: Contractor’s aerial shows the stepped RCC wall, seven chutes, two lower outlets, crest crane, riverside generator hall and open surge shafts. Contractor gives 630 m crest, 250 m maximum height and ten generating units.
Project design lists a 896 m crest and 889 m normal headwater, with earlier wall dimensions. The model uses contractor length and height for the exterior.
Retained dam area constrains the crest alignment and trapezoidal downstream footprint.
